body:
### Describe the solution you'd like

Verify and/or implement telemetry support for the Standalone Activities feature.
- Activity worker executing standalone activities should emit equivalent metrics to what is emitted when executing workflow activities, with appropriate activity ID and run ID tags.
- All `ActivityClient` calls should emit appropriate metrics.
- Add `class OpenTelemetryActivityClientInterceptor implements ActivityClientInterceptor`.

### Additional context

Standalone Activities PR: https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-typescript/pull/2029
title: [Feature Request] Telemetry support for Standalone Activities
